mission: From the Android phone, enter one coding prompt and have a durable Fortress campaign continuously execute, review, repair, verify, and persist coding work through the existing phone kernel and Chromium Throne desktop swarm until Venice permits STOP.

entrypoint.bootstrap: cd /storage/emulated/0/Documents/GodotProjects/home-center && git fetch origin feat/fortress-phone-swarm-campaign && git show origin/feat/fortress-phone-swarm-campaign:tools/fortress_phone_swarm_bootstrap.sh | bash

stepOne: Before branch mutation or daemon install, capture git status --porcelain=v2 --branch, stash tracked and untracked work with a fortress-rescue timestamp, prove the stash OID/stat, prove the worktree is clean, and persist the reversible restore receipt. Never reset a dirty tree before this receipt exists.

processModel.roleSupervisor: each tmux role runs through fortress_supervise.sh; crashes are logged and restarted with bounded exponential backoff
processModel.boot: single Termux:Boot tmux supervisor; legacy nohup PID supervisor is removed to prevent split brain
processModel.loop: observe -> compare -> decide -> act -> verify -> persist -> backoff -> observe

execution.phoneTruth: SQLite/WAL campaign, kernel, and Throne-adapter state in Termux
execution.phoneAdapter: loopback compatibility adapter at 127.0.0.1:17373; it contains no ChatGPT/browser implementation and only translates the campaign task contract onto the existing Throne relay
execution.desktopMuscle: current Chromium Throne extension swarm: service-worker-owned parallel visible ChatGPT workers, Pro reasoning doctrine, primary Judgment-Jar Venice, durable continuation/handoff states
execution.transport: phone-local adapter -> SSH Axis -> THECAULDRON -> existing browser-porch/throne-client.mjs + loopback browser-porch relay -> Chromium Throne extension
execution.secretBoundary: relay capability is generated/stored/used on THECAULDRON; it is not copied to the phone
execution.peerRecovery: SSH Axis proves THECAULDRON, repairs/starts the existing loopback relay, writes the installed extension relay config, and wakes the dedicated Throne browser; no parallel remote-control architecture
execution.workerMode: Chat mode; Pro reasoning where configurable; PORTCULLIS LOCKED

judgment.vladLocalJarCache: consume if present via VLAD_JUDGMENT_JARS or discovered local cache; never relocate/rebuild it from this campaign
judgment.stopRule: Only a durable Venice STOP_ALLOWED or HALT_REQUIRED can terminate normal work. A worker finishing or a ChatGPT response boundary cannot.
judgment.extensionGate: Chromium Throne workers independently enforce Judgment-Jar Venice PLAN_ALLOWED/STOP_ALLOWED/CONTINUE_REQUIRED inside each bounded slice; the phone campaign adds a mission-level Venice stop gate on top.

dirtyTree.policy: unique dirty/untracked work is treasure and must be preserved before infrastructure changes
dirtyTree.restore: receipt stores the exact stash OID; restoration uses git stash apply --index <oid> rather than assuming stash@{0} remains stable

capabilityState.tested: source review and deterministic regression fixtures present; native phone execution still required

durableDesktopEvidence: THECAULDRON previously accepted the Chromium Throne visible single-tab scaffold through Computer Hands. knownRuntimeBoundary: This ChatGPT surface currently lacks callable Home Center Phone Hands/Computer Hands, so repository implementation cannot be promoted to deployed/callable. parallelWorkConstraint: A separate campaign is moving Judgment Jars to fast local Vlad access. This campaign consumes that cache opportunistically and must never duplicate, relocate, or overwrite it.
